description: Reliability hardening for matrix_control.ps1 - fix critical bugs identified in code review for public release readiness

userStories.title: Safe Atomic File Write
userStories.description: As a user, I want settings.json writes to be truly atomic so that my Windows Terminal settings are never lost or corrupted.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace delete+rename pattern with Move-Item -Force in Save-TerminalEffects function
Write to temp file first, then move to overwrite original
If move fails, original file remains intact (no data loss)
Add try-catch with user-friendly error message on failure
PowerShell script runs without errors
userStories.notes: Implemented Move-Item -Force with try-catch error handling. Commit: 97e02de

userStories.title: JSON Error Handling
userStories.description: As a user, I want the control panel to handle corrupted or locked settings gracefully so that it doesn't crash unexpectedly.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrap all ConvertFrom-Json calls in try-catch blocks
Wrap all file read/write operations in try-catch blocks
Display clear error message when settings.json is malformed
Display clear error message when settings.json is locked by another process
Script continues running in degraded mode rather than crashing
PowerShell script runs without errors

userStories.title: Shader Value Validation
userStories.description: As a user, I want shader parameter parsing to reject invalid values so that shaders always compile correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Regex pattern in Load-Shader rejects multiple decimal points (e.g. 1.2.3)
Regex pattern only matches valid float format: ^\d+\.?\d*$
Invalid values fall back to defaults from $defaults hashtable
Display warning message when invalid value detected
PowerShell script runs without errors

userStories.title: Auto-Save on Tab Switch
userStories.description: As a user, I want my shader changes automatically saved when switching tabs so that I never lose work.
acceptanceCriteria: Check $dirty flag before switching tabs (Tab key handler)
If dirty, call Save-Shader for current slot before loading new tab
Display brief 'Auto-saved' message after saving
Clear dirty flag after auto-save
No user action required to preserve changes
PowerShell script runs without errors

userStories.title: Remove Dead Code
userStories.description: As a developer, I want dead code removed so that the codebase is clean and maintainable.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove space key (VK 32) handler - transparency already auto-saves on B/K/L keys
Remove any unreachable or unused code paths
Verify all keyboard controls still work after removal
Update comments to reflect current behavior
PowerShell script runs without errors

userStories.title: Robust Window Detection
userStories.description: As a user, I want window detection to accurately identify Matrix windows so that launching and positioning work correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Get-OpenMatrixSlots matches windows by exact title pattern Matrix-N where N is 1-8
Filter to only WindowsTerminal process windows (check process name)
Ignore non-Windows Terminal processes with similar titles
Return accurate sorted list of open slot numbers
PowerShell script runs without errors

userStories.title: Robust Window Positioning
userStories.description: As a user, I want window positioning to work reliably regardless of handle values so that windows are always arranged correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Position-MatrixWindows matches handles to specific Matrix-N windows by title
Do not rely on handle value sort order
Position windows in slot order (Matrix-1 leftmost, Matrix-2 next, etc.)
Handle case where slots are non-sequential (e.g. only Matrix-1 and Matrix-3)
PowerShell script runs without errors

userStories.title: Poll-Based Window Launch
userStories.description: As a user, I want window launching to be responsive and reliable so that I don't wait unnecessarily.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace fixed 1500ms Start-Sleep with polling loop in Launch-MatrixWindows
Poll every 100ms for window title to appear
Timeout after 5 seconds with error message
Proceed immediately when window is detected
Display progress indicator: Waiting for Matrix-N...
PowerShell script runs without errors

userStories.title: Add Diagnostic Logging
userStories.description: As a developer, I want diagnostic logging so that issues can be debugged when users report problems.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Write-Log helper function that writes to $matrixDir\debug.log
Log only when $env:MATRIX_DEBUG equals 1
Log key operations: file saves, window detection, launches, positioning
Log errors with context (operation, values involved)
Logs don't appear in normal operation (clean UI preserved)
PowerShell script runs without errors

userStories.title: Consolidate Key Handlers
userStories.description: As a developer, I want duplicate key handlers consolidated so that code is DRY and maintainable.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Handle-Key helper that normalizes to lowercase before matching
Replace duplicate uppercase/lowercase switch cases with single entries
Reduce key handling code by approximately 30%
All existing keyboard controls still work identically
PowerShell script runs without errors
